description.value: Meridian Farm Market is a farm-focused grocery store in Maple Ridge offering a wide range of locally sourced and craft products including grass-fed beef, free-run chicken, fresh produce, artisan cheese, and baked goods. It operates as both a physical retail location and an online ordering service with delivery across the Lower Mainland. Touring cyclists passing through Maple Ridge would find it a well-stocked stop for resupply across most food categories.
